title: RFC005 §26.4/§26.6 Stage (loss) Policy
$comment: Closed envelope for the artifact `stage_policy_hash` names. RFC005 §26.4: every λ_f is explicit, versioned and stored in a loss policy; dynamic weighting only through a named algorithm with its own hash and bounded behavior, and it may not read validation/test metrics back inside one run. §26.6: the policy carries a closed exact-RFC003-task_kind -> loss families -> head IDs / output locators allowlist; an unspecified pair is disabled and wildcards are forbidden. The concrete λ values, the stage id and the allowlist rows are owner content decisions -- this schema fixes their SHAPE and refuses the malformed, it does not supply them. The loss family names are deliberately NOT enumerated here: `stage_policy.py` requires exactly the families in `training_materializer.LOSS_FAMILY_IDS`, so a family added there becomes required of every policy without anyone having to remember this file.

stage_id.$comment: The RFC005 §12 stage this policy weights. Named, never inferred from a run class.

loss_weights_milli.$comment: λ_f per loss family (§26.4), in MILLI-units: the stored integer is 1000·λ_f, so λ=1.0 is 1000. Integer because the deterministic CBOR profile this hash is computed under (`rfc8949-core-det-nfc-int-v0`) has no float in its data model at all -- a float λ is not representable in the identity, and the repository already carries scaled integers for exactly this reason (`width_mpt`, `rotation_mdeg`). The unit is in the field name so a caller cannot pass λ and mean 1.0. Exactly the LOSS_FAMILY_IDS family set is required by the producer; a zero weight is refused by the schema, because disabling a family belongs in `task_view_allowlist` ('an unspecified pair is disabled'), not in a weight that still looks configured.

dynamic_weighting.$comment: §26.4: allowed only through a named algorithm with its own hash and bounded behavior. `null` means static λ. There is no default: the field is required, so 'static' is a declaration.

reads_validation_or_test_metrics.$comment: §26.4 forbids feeding validation/test metrics back into weighting inside one run. Required and const false, so the prohibition is recorded in the policy identity rather than assumed.

task_view_allowlist.$comment: §26.6. One row per (task_kind, loss_family) pair that is ENABLED; any pair absent from this list is disabled. Row-per-pair rather than per-task is what makes 'one output logit must not enter two loss families' checkable at all.

task_kind.$comment: An exact RFC003 task_kind. Membership in the closed RFC003 enum is checked by the producer against `unflatten.dataset.enums.TASK_KIND`, not restated here. The pattern only rules out the wildcard forms §26.6 bans outright.
